opening: Can you make a page at /standup for our morning stand-up? When someone opens it, everyone else who has it open should see their name show up right away, and there should be an "I'm ready" button: when someone presses it, the others see it immediately, without reloading. It's for signed-in team members only.
goal: a page at /standup where signed-in members see each other arrive live and see each other's 'ready' live; guests cannot open it
later: what happens when someone closes the page — do they disappear for the others?
checklist: a second member's open page shows the first member's name without reloading
pressing ready shows up on the other member's page without reloading
it was tested with two people, or the assistant says it was not
facts: Live presence and live messages between open pages are the room capability (room.peers, room.emit/on); db onSnapshot also updates live.
Names come from the user capability (profiles); a page without it shows ids.
personaKnows: You can sign in on the site. You will try it with a colleague in two browsers.
